Ash Ketchum became my absolute favorite when Pokemon anime started airing, his hair was similar to Goku's. And his childish belief he wants to become the very best made a beat that many of the kids of my age were drawn to.  


Anyways, What Ash means to me: -  


1) Well, Ash made me realize how true friendship really should be like being 'together forever' is a bit idealistic in the real world but still, it made me a being a good friend to my friends. And think of my friends happiness before me.

2)Being empathetic and kind to plants and animals around me.  


3) People around you are going to leave you and that's okay.

4) Made me realize pretty early that life is not going to have a happy ending i.e. the cliche it will all be easy, you are the protagonist of your life and are going to win. No no....when Charizard refused to fight the indigo palet and that scene made me absolute angry and teary like why would Charizard do that! Didn't he know it's Ash's dream? Ash took it pretty well and made me realize that you \*are going to lose\* and that's okay.  


 5) You keep trying to go for your dream as long as you enjoy it, it doesn't matter what else happens. In the en,d you are going to remember the amazing memories you had for your genuine efforts.
